character.description: Character window: transparent Live2D surface. Drag, model manifest, click-through toggle and speech playback reporting only; no settings writes, no shell, no fs.

chat.description: Chat window: conversation history and text input. Exposes app status, message submission and turn cancellation.

settings.description: Settings window: diagnostics and configuration. Exposes app status, character control, microphone / STT control and LLM settings.
